# ECN-2026-003 - Change notice - Hot Forge CNC turning center #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-CN02

Reason for change
- Background: During the quarterly maintenance review of EQ-P1-L1-CN02, maintenance and production teams identified inconsistent spindle lubrication reports and an increase in minor bearing noise events documented in the maintenance log. Field inspection found multiple lubricant containers in use with inconsistent labeling and no single approved supplier record for this asset in the equipment master. To standardize lubrication practice and reduce variability in preventive maintenance outcomes, a single approved lubricant part number is being adopted for EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
- Objective: Establish and document the approved lubricant for EQ-P1-L1-CN02 to ensure consistent procurement, storage, application, and recordkeeping across P1-L1.
- Scope: This ECN standardizes lubricant selection only. It does not alter machine settings, cycle parameters, or SOP machining steps covered in SOP-P1-L1-02 and SOP-P1-L1-04 beyond lubrication application steps specified below.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-CN02 (Hot Forge CNC turning center #2).
- Consumable: Lubricant for spindle and guideways for EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
- Documentation: Update equipment master entry and maintenance task cards referenced in MM-P1-L1-CN02 to reflect the approved lubricant part number.
- Procedures: Revise the lubrication steps in SOP-P1-L1-02 and SOP-P1-L1-04 where they refer to lubricant selection or procurement. Changes will be limited to lubricant identification and storage instructions; machine operation steps remain unchanged.
- Inventory and procurement: Update procurement catalog and bin labeling in storeroom to show the approved part number for EQ-P1-L1-CN02.

Approved lubricant
- The lubricant part number for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is CFW-LUB-508 (part number).

Implementation
- Procurement and inventory
  - Update the storeroom inventory and procurement system entries for all P1-L1 lubricant stock that can service EQ-P1-L1-CN02 to include CFW-LUB-508 (part number). Place a reorder flag on existing stock of CFW-LUB-508 to maintain continuity of supply.
  - Remove unapproved lubricant containers from the immediate maintenance staging area for EQ-P1-L1-CN02 and quarantine them with labeling indicating "Not for EQ-P1-L1-CN02" until disposition per MM-P1-L1-CN02.
- Labeling and storage
  - Label the lubricant cabinet and spares bin that support EQ-P1-L1-CN02 with the approved part number CFW-LUB-508 (part number). Include date received and batch/lot information on each container at time of receipt to support traceability.
- Maintenance procedure updates
  - Modify the lubrication line items in MM-P1-L1-CN02 to list CFW-LUB-508 (part number) as the required consumable for any lubrication tasks on EQ-P1-L1-CN02. Retain existing task intervals and task descriptions as documented in MM-P1-L1-CN02; only the consumable reference is updated.
  - Amend SOP-P1-L1-02 and SOP-P1-L1-04 sections that instruct operators or technicians to identify or top up lubricant to explicitly require CFW-LUB-508 (part number) for EQ-P1-L1-CN02. Add an instruction to verify part number on the container prior to application.
- Training and communication
  - Conduct a short training brief for maintenance technicians and relevant operators covering the change to CFW-LUB-508 (part number). Training will include: how to verify part number, storage/handling notes, and updates to MM-P1-L1-CN02, SOP-P1-L1-02, and SOP-P1-L1-04 references.
  - Issue a change communication bulletin to affected personnel that references MM-P1-L1-CN02, SOP-P1-L1-02, and SOP-P1-L1-04.
- Field implementation steps (example)
  - Example record entry when applying lubricant: record asset EQ-P1-L1-CN02, task per MM-P1-L1-CN02, lubricant applied CFW-LUB-508 (part number), container lot/batch, date, technician initials, and reason code if application deviates from scheduled maintenance. Use the existing maintenance log format; add a single line field for "Lubricant PN" where CFW-LUB-508 (part number) is entered.
  - Example storeroom action: upon receipt of new shipment, label each container with "CFW-LUB-508" and enter lot/batch in the storeroom ledger. Reconcile existing inventory against newly updated procurement entries.
- Timing and cutover
  - Implementation will occur during the next scheduled maintenance window for EQ-P1-L1-CN02. Until cutover, do not change current maintenance intervals or tasks in MM-P1-L1-CN02; only transition consumables to CFW-LUB-508 (part number) when new stock is available.

Records to keep
- Update and retain records in accordance with MM-P1-L1-CN02 retention requirements. Minimum records to capture for each lubrication event on EQ-P1-L1-CN02:
  - Equipment identifier: EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
  - Lubricant part number: CFW-LUB-508 (part number).
  - Container lot/batch and receiving date.
  - Technician name/initials and date of application.
  - Reference to maintenance task as per MM-P1-L1-CN02.
- Maintain procurement and receipt records for CFW-LUB-508 (part number) in the storeroom system for audit and quality traceability.
- Retain change training attendance records and the issuance log for the communication bulletin referencing SOP-P1-L1-02 and SOP-P1-L1-04.

Approvals
- The following approvals are required to enact this ECN:
  - Maintenance Manager (approval to update MM-P1-L1-CN02 and storeroom entries).
  - Production Supervisor (approval for operator-facing SOP updates SOP-P1-L1-02 and SOP-P1-L1-04).
  - Quality Assurance (approval to accept CFW-LUB-508 (part number) as the controlled consumable and to update audit checklists).
- Documentation updates to MM-P1-L1-CN02, SOP-P1-L1-02, and SOP-P1-L1-04 must be completed and recorded prior to the full cutover to CFW-LUB-508 (part number). Signatures and dates for each approval shall be recorded on the ECN approval page and attached to the ECN record in the document control system.

Related documents
- MM-P1-L1-CN02
- SOP-P1-L1-02
- SOP-P1-L1-04

End of ECN-2026-003 Rev E.
